scoring_justification: Checker implements Wills-Harrison pair potential formula and recomputes Ud and Fd from agent-reported distances and shell occupancies, then cross-checks energy difference consistency and positivity.

hidden_assets.purpose: Element parameters (Z_d, R_d, n_d(E_F)) and physical constants used as the hidden gold for recomputation.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 and standard physical constants
hidden_assets.generation_method: Hardcoded from the published values; no external file
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the exact published parameters from the paper's own Table 1; they are not fabricated.

outputs.description: Accumulated d-electron free energies per shell for V, Cr, Mn, Fe in bcc, fcc, hcp using nearest-neighbor and extended methods. The checker recomputes the quantities from the input parameters and lattice geometry, comparing within tolerance, and uses these to compute energy differences.

Energy differences ΔF^{fcc-bcc} and ΔF^{fcc-hcp} derived from the free energies. The checker recomputes these differences from free_energies.csv and verifies they are positive for all shells (up to at least 10), confirming bcc stability.

output_contract.notes: The checker will recompute cumulative free energies and energy differences from free_energies.csv using the given formulas and input parameters, and verify the positivity of ΔF values, all within appropriate numerical tolerances.

steps.description: Recompute pair potential Ud and cumulative free energy Fd from agent-reported distances and shell occupancies using the Wills-Harrison formula and input parameters; compare within 0.001 Ry tolerance.
Verify that energy differences are consistent with reported free energies (within 0.001 Ry) and that all ΔF values are positive for shells ≤ 10, confirming bcc stability.
